Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice
Terma is an international technology company delivering mission-critical solutions for defense, aerospace and security . Headquartered in Denmark, we develop advanced systems that protect people on land, at sea, in the air, and in space
 Would you like to work with advanced technology while traveling the world? In this role, you will combine hands-on technical work with international collaboration – come and join us! 
 We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for an IT Infrastructure Engineer o become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 About the Role 
 Terma Romania is seeking an IT Infrastructure Engineer to join our innovative Space team.
 As part of the Electrical Ground Systems Center of Excellence, the I T Infrastructure Engineer will support the core business across one or multiple application areas, being responsible for project implementation and delivery of customer projects within the Terma Space Business Area.
 You will join a team characterized by strong team spirit and close collaboration. The environment is supportive, with a culture of open and direct feedback. Knowledge sharing and helping each other are a natural part of the daily work.
 Required skills and experience: 
Network architecture and implementation at CCNA level
Installation and configuration of Windows and Linux operating systems, including underlying system and architecture components
Ability to write clear documentations related to design and test procedures
 General Work Skills: 
Problem solving
Good analytical skills
High degree of interpersonal awareness
Experience in working as part of a multicultural team
Ability to work autonomously and to perform context switch
 Job responsibilities: 
Works creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment demonstrating teamwork, innovation and excellence
Provide support in the tender process
Liaise with relevant departments (Delivery, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Excellence, etc.) and other internal and external stakeholders
Evaluate technical performance and take corrective measures in case of deviations from the target
Contribute to process improvement initiatives as it relates to improving project delivery.
 Required Qualifications: 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a relevant field
Proven track record of strong contribution to successful IT projects implementation
Excellent command of English
 Nice to have: 
Minimum 3 years of experience with rack design and implementation,
DevOps skills including CI/CD pipeline design and operation, using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, Ansible etc
Experience with Active Directory, LDAP, or similar IAM systems
Scripting skills (Shell, Python, etc.) for automating system installations, configurations, and operational workflows
Experience coordinating with various teams and team members
Interest and foundational know-how in Cyber Security
Understanding of software development processes and lifecycle
Familiarity with ESA standards
 Personal profile: 
Work with integrity
Flexibility and ability to adapt to change with confidence and commitment
Resilience and social competence to successfully interact with all necessary internal and external stakeholders
Take ownership and responsibility
Eagerness to learn
Analytical and solution oriented
Well-structured and able to solve complex problems
 We offer: 
Meal vouchers currently 45 RON per meal ticket
Annual salary increase based on the inflation rate, in accordance with our Collective Labor Agreement
Flexible working hours, with the option to convert flex-time into time off
Private medical insurance
Critical illness insurance covered by the employer
Group life insurance covered by the employer
Personalized Christmas gift package, chosen individually by each employee
25 vacation days
 Do you have any questions regarding the position? 
 Feel free to contact Oana Olteanu on e-mail: oano@terma.com
